entries.name: COF-1
entries.phase: COF-1：无客体 DFT 宿主模型，档案起始层堆垛为交错型。

source.name: Materials Cloud CURATED covalent organic frameworks database
source.citation: D. Ongari et al., Building a consistent and reproducible database for adsorption evaluation in Covalent-Organic Frameworks, Materials Cloud Archive 2021.100 (2021), DOI: 10.24435/materialscloud:z6-jn.
source.version: Materials Cloud Archive 2021.100, version v9 (June 2021 snapshot)
source.conditions: The source archive describes DFT-optimized coordinates and unit cell. Its paper identifies record 05000N2 as the COF-1 model initialized with staggered layers. The original 2005 report describes as-synthesized COF-1 with mesitylene guests (DOI: 10.1126/science.1120411); those guest atoms are absent from this archive CIF, which is the DFT-optimized host model. Source CIF charge metadata remains raw-only.

entries.name: COF-5
entries.phase: COF-5：层间滑移 DFT 模型，沿 c 轴采用 2 倍重复。

source.name: Materials Cloud CURATED covalent organic frameworks database

source.version: Materials Cloud Archive 2021.100, version v9 (June 2021 snapshot)
source.conditions: The source archive describes DFT-optimized coordinates and unit cell; its paper states that 05001N2 starts from the reported eclipsed COF-5 model, then relaxes to a lower-energy laterally shifted layer geometry (DOI: 10.1021/acscentsci.9b00619). The source curation note says the cell is replicated 2x in C; this pipeline adds no further repeat. Source CIF charge metadata remains raw-only.
